Frequently Asked Questions

Does Olive Young ship internationally?

Olive Young Korea has limited direct international coverage. We can attempt eligible purchases, then show available routes after warehouse packing and measurement.

How long does shipping take?

Transit estimates depend on the eligible carrier, destination, customs, and dispatch date. Available services and estimates are shown after packing and measurement.

Can I combine multiple Olive Young orders?

Consolidation may be available where practical after items reach the warehouse; packing needs and measured shipping determine the final cost.
